design.legacy: original R3B rhs unchanged, zero ghost face averages retained; evolve scalar psi alongside gradients for diagnostics
design.candidate: same radial constraints, RK4, interior finite-volume flux and dissipation; integrate scalar psi_t=(alpha/a)Pi; at outer ghosts extrapolate outgoing Pi-Phi and impose incoming Pi+Phi=-psi/r (spherical Sommerfeld, exact for flat outgoing spherical wave, approximate curved BC); use ghost values in actual flux and dissipation stencil; no geometry update changes
design.face: compute numerical face U=(vPi)_face and W=(vPhi)_face from exact same reconstruction as RHS; independent signed energy flux F=4pi R² U W/(v_R a_R²); v_R=1-2M/R, a_R^-2=v_R, so F=4pi R² U W at physical boundary with solver lapse normalization; not exactly conservative ADM mass discretization, separate balance tested; dissipation not silently included in inferred physical flux
design.legacy_estimator: also report old 1.5/-0.5 center field extrapolated flux for every case; never use mass difference to estimate flux
design.flat_analytic: initial exact spherical Gaussian solution psi=A*(exp(-((r+t-r0)/w)^2)-exp(-((-r+t-r0)/w)^2))/r; Phi,Pi analytic initial(r,A,r0,w,t); flat mass proxy E=2pi sum r²(Phi²+Pi²)h, compare numerical flux to analytic boundary flux integrated on identical times, analytical energy difference is independent check
design.comparisons: reflection measured at r=10, t in [12,22] using incoming characteristic Pi+Phi+psi/r; norm of error versus analytic flat or large-domain curved reference divided by reference outgoing characteristic norm Pi-Phi-psi/r, plus full field L2 on same coordinate time; time sampling same steps for equal h, no alignment; curved reference at r12.5 flux integrated independently, compare actual outer direct face; report reflection proxy, not exact scattering coefficient

gates.central_comparison: signed central derivative and both Ricci proxies on common central proper time, 32769 points, no shift, no cropping; preserve original 12288 and 24576 peak/mass/scale exact within 1e-8 if legacy replay
gates.boundary_reference: curved reference domain closed mass budget <1%, net outward at interior >=25%, flux-corrected balance; candidate open raw drift is physical loss, not gate

design.scope: run both BC arms flat and curved small; curved large reference legacy (boundary causally remote for pulse); candidate critical pair plus legacy replay pair and extended-domain candidate. All predeclared gates independent. No 49152, DSS, AMR, critical exponent or threshold fitting.

limitations: Characteristic Sommerfeld is approximate in curved spacetime; one weak pulse does not establish all boundary regimes.
Direct numerical face flux is a diagnostic based on face field fluxes, not a proven exactly conservative discretization of Misner-Sharp mass; explicit KO term may contribute residual.
A passing domain extension is finite-time evidence only; lapse normalization differences may persist.
